about: Bible twenty questions: hand corrections of values the site data gets wrong, and the hand slip list (design §4.1). Checked by tq_build.py: a correction may only name a data-owned tag, must differ from the data stage's value (else it is stale and the build fails), and carries a one-line reason. Values: [letter, reason] or [letter, reason, 'BOOK c:v' verse]. Slips: values players often get wrong; treated as unsure in guess mode, applied only where the final value is yes or no. The model passes (model.values.json) add their own slips.
